WITH enriched_results AS (
  SELECT
    sr.*,
    COALESCE(gw.metadata->>'technology', 'Unknown') as gw_technology,
    COALESCE(gw.metadata->>'network_type', 'Unknown') as gw_network_type,
    COALESCE(gw.metadata->>'modem_name', 'Unknown') as gw_model,
    COALESCE(gw.metadata->>'firmware_version', 'Unknown') as gw_firmware,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(gw.metadata->>'cable_mac_address', 'Unknown'), NULLIF(gw.metadata->>'pon_mac_address', 'Unknown'), 'Unknown') as gw_mac
  FROM script_results sr
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT metadata
    FROM script_results gw
    WHERE gw.script_name = 'gw_info' AND gw.success = true AND gw.host_name = sr.host_name AND gw.started_at <= sr.started_at
    ORDER BY gw.started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) gw ON true
  WHERE sr.script_name = 'ookla_speedtest'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as "Nr. of total test",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = false) as "Nr. of failed test",
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = true)::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)) * 100, 1) as "Success Rate"
FROM enriched_results
WHERE 1=1  AND success::text = ANY(string_to_array('${success:csv}', ','))
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ('${host:csv}' = '' OR host_name = ANY(string_to_array('${host:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${device_name:csv}' = '' OR device_name = ANY(string_to_array('${device_name:csv}', ',')))
  AND ('${server:csv}' = '' OR metadata->>'server_name' = ANY(string_to_array('${server:csv}', ',')) OR metadata->>'server_name' IS NULL)
  AND ('${technology:csv}' = '' OR gw_technology = ANY(string_to_array('${technology:csv}', ',')) OR gw_technology IS NULL)
  AND ('${network:csv}' = '' OR gw_network_type = ANY(string_to_array('${network:csv}', ',')) OR gw_network_type IS NULL)
  AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR gw_model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')) OR gw_model IS NULL)
  AND ('${firmware:csv}' = '' OR gw_firmware = ANY(string_to_array('${firmware:csv}', ',')) OR gw_firmware IS NULL)
  AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ',')))

SELECT 
  started_at as "Time",
  CASE WHEN success THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END as "Status",
  NULLIF(CONCAT(metadata->>'server_name', ' (', metadata->>'server_id', ')'), ' ()') as "Ookla Server",
  metadata->>'server_location' as "Server Location",
  (metadata->>'download_mbps')::numeric as "Download",
  (metadata->>'upload_mbps')::numeric as "Upload",
  (metadata->>'ping_latency_ms')::numeric as "Latency",
  (metadata->>'ping_jitter_ms')::numeric as "Jitter",
  (metadata->>'packet_loss_percent')::numeric as "Loss %",
  error_msg as "Error",
  metadata->>'result_url' as "Ookla Result URL"
FROM enriched_results

  AND ('${environment:csv}' = '' OR environment = ANY(string_to_array('${environment:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 100

list.label: Host
list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host_name FROM script_results WHERE script_name = 'ookla_speedtest' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY host_name

list.label: Device
list.name: device_name
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_name FROM script_results WHERE script_name = 'ookla_speedtest' AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY device_name

list.label: Ookla Server
list.name: server
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metadata->>'server_name' as server FROM script_results WHERE script_name = 'ookla_speedtest' AND metadata->>'server_name' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY server
